headline: Get to know Teruaki Sato
caption:
🇯🇵➡️🇺🇸 Get to know Teruaki Sato, the Cubs' new $120M slugger.

Back-to-back Central League MVP. NPB's 9th-ever Triple Crown (.306, 39 HR, 106 RBI). The first Shigeo Nagashima Award winner. Swipe for everything you need to know, plus 5 things you probably didn't 👉
